legend_toml:
# Debt-recovery letter pack: legend for the three chasing letters
#
#   reminder.tpl.md          (a) friendly payment reminder
#   second-reminder.tpl.md   (b) second reminder
#   final-demand.tpl.md      (c) final demand: letter before action (company)
#                                or Letter of Claim under the Pre-Action
#                                Protocol for Debt Claims (individual / sole trader)
#
# The statutory late-payment interest claim (d) has its own legend,
# statutory-interest.toml, because it only applies between businesses.
#
# Variables with no default and `required = false` are needed only by the
# letters or branches that use them: a letter that reaches one unbound is
# refused with "'NAME' is not bound", never rendered with a gap.
#
# Amounts are not calculated here. The app computes AMOUNT_OUTSTANDING,
# interest and totals and binds them; see README.md for the formulas.
#
# All scenario data below is fictional.

[legend]
name = "Debt recovery letters (England and Wales)"

# --- Creditor (the sender) ---------------------------------------------------

[[var]]
name = "CREDITOR_NAME"
type = "string"
required = true
description = "Your business name as it appears on the invoice"

[[var]]
name = "CREDITOR_ADDRESS"
type = "list"
sep = "|"
join = ", "
required = true
description = "Postal address lines. Also the address the Reply Form goes back to."

[[var]]
name = "CREDITOR_EMAIL"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "CREDITOR_PHONE"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "SIGNATORY"
type = "string"
required = true
description = "Name of the person signing"

[[var]]
name = "SIGNATORY_ROLE"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "CLOSING"
type = "string"
value = "Yours sincerely,"
description = "Use \"Yours faithfully,\" when SALUTATION is \"Sir or Madam\""

# --- Debtor -------------------------------------------------------------------

[[var]]
name = "DEBTOR_TYPE"
type = "enum"
values = ["company", "sole_trader", "individual"]
required = true
description = "company (incl. LLP): letter before action under the Practice Direction on Pre-Action Conduct. sole_trader / individual: Letter of Claim under the Pre-Action Protocol for Debt Claims."

[[var]]
name = "DEBTOR_NAME"
type = "string"
required = true
description = "Company name, or the person's full name (sole trader: \"Name trading as Business\")"

[[var]]
name = "DEBTOR_ADDRESS"
type = "list"
sep = "|"
join = ", "
required = true

[[var]]
name = "SALUTATION"
type = "string"
required = true
description = "Follows \"Dear\", e.g. \"Ms Morgan\" or \"Sir or Madam\""

# --- This letter ----------------------------------------------------------------

[[var]]
name = "LETTER_DATE"
type = "date"
required = true
description = "Date printed at the top. A Letter of Claim should be posted on this date or the next day."

[[var]]
name = "OUR_REF"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "PREVIOUS_LETTER_DATE"
type = "date"
description = "Second reminder: date of the first reminder"

[[var]]
name = "PAY_BY"
type = "date"
description = "Reminders: date by which payment is requested"

[[var]]
name = "RESPONSE_DEADLINE"
type = "date"
description = "Final demand to a company: date for payment or a response. Practice Direction – Pre-Action Conduct para 6(b): 14 days is a reasonable time in a straightforward case."

# --- The debt ---------------------------------------------------------------------

[[var]]
name = "GOODS_OR_SERVICES"
type = "string"
required = true
description = "What was supplied, e.g. \"the fabrication and delivery of 40 steel brackets\""

[[var]]
name = "INVOICE_NUMBERS"
type = "list"
sep = ","
join = ", "
required = true

[[var]]
name = "INVOICE_DATE"
type = "date"
required = true
description = "Invoice date (the earliest, if several)"

[[var]]
name = "DUE_DATE"
type = "date"
required = true
description = "Date payment was due (the earliest, if several)"

[[var]]
name = "DAYS_OVERDUE"
type = "int"
min = 1
required = true

[[var]]
name = "INVOICE_TOTAL"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "AMOUNT_PAID"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
value = "0"

[[var]]
name = "AMOUNT_OUTSTANDING"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
required = true
description = "INVOICE_TOTAL less AMOUNT_PAID"

[[var]]
name = "PAYMENT_STATUS"
type = "enum"
values = ["unpaid", "partial", "plan_offered"]
value = "unpaid"
description = "unpaid; partial (a part payment was received); plan_offered (you offer to take instalments)"

[[var]]
name = "LAST_PAYMENT_DATE"
type = "date"
description = "partial: date the part payment was received"

[[var]]
name = "PLAN_INSTALMENT"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
description = "plan_offered: amount of each instalment"

[[var]]
name = "PLAN_COUNT"
type = "int"
min = 2
description = "plan_offered: number of instalments"

[[var]]
name = "PLAN_FREQUENCY"
type = "enum"
values = ["weekly", "monthly"]
value = "monthly"

[[var]]
name = "PLAN_FIRST_DATE"
type = "date"
description = "plan_offered: date of the first instalment"

[[var]]
name = "PLAN_ACCEPT_BY"
type = "date"
description = "plan_offered: date by which the debtor should accept the plan"

# --- Interest ---------------------------------------------------------------------

[[var]]
name = "CLAIM_STATUTORY_INTEREST"
type = "bool"
value = "false"
description = "Final demand to a company or sole trader: add statutory interest and fixed-sum compensation under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998. Ignored for individuals."

[[var]]
name = "INTEREST_RATE"
type = "string"
description = "Statutory rate in % a year: 8 plus the reference rate, e.g. \"12.00\""

[[var]]
name = "INTEREST_TO_DATE"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
description = "Statutory interest accrued up to LETTER_DATE"

[[var]]
name = "DAILY_INTEREST"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
description = "Statutory interest per day: principal x rate / 365"

[[var]]
name = "DEBT_BAND"
type = "enum"
values = ["under_1000", "1000_to_9999", "10000_or_more"]
description = "Size of the debt, which fixes the s.5A compensation: less than £1,000; £1,000 or more but less than £10,000; £10,000 or more"

[[var]]
name = "COMPENSATION"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
by = "DEBT_BAND"
description = "Fixed sum under s.5A(2) of the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998; follows DEBT_BAND"
[var.map]
under_1000 = "40"
1000_to_9999 = "70"
10000_or_more = "100"

[[var]]
name = "TOTAL_CLAIMED"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
description = "Final demand: AMOUNT_OUTSTANDING plus any interest and compensation claimed"

[[var]]
name = "INTEREST_CONTINUING"
type = "bool"
value = "false"
description = "Final demand to an individual or sole trader (not claiming statutory interest): whether contractual interest or other charges are still being added"

[[var]]
name = "INTEREST_DETAILS"
type = "string"
description = "INTEREST_CONTINUING: what is being added, at what rate, under which term"

# --- Agreement (Letter of Claim, Pre-Action Protocol para 3.1(a)(iii)-(iv)) --------

[[var]]
name = "AGREEMENT_TYPE"
type = "enum"
values = ["written", "oral"]
value = "written"

[[var]]
name = "AGREEMENT_DATE"
type = "date"
description = "written: date of the agreement"

[[var]]
name = "AGREEMENT_DESCRIPTION"
type = "string"
description = "written: what the agreement is, e.g. \"our quotation Q-2291, which you accepted by email\""

[[var]]
name = "ORAL_AGREEMENT"
type = "string"
description = "oral: who made the agreement, what was agreed (as far as possible, the words used), and when and where"

[[var]]
name = "INSTALMENTS_OFFERED"
type = "bool"
value = "false"
description = "Letter of Claim: the debtor is offering or paying regular instalments (Protocol para 3.1(a)(vi))"

[[var]]
name = "INSTALMENT_OFFER"
type = "string"
description = "INSTALMENTS_OFFERED: the debtor's offer, e.g. \"£10 a month\""

[[var]]
name = "OFFER_REJECTION_REASON"
type = "string"
description = "INSTALMENTS_OFFERED: why the offer is not acceptable and a claim is still being considered"

# --- Payment details -------------------------------------------------------------

[[var]]
name = "PAYEE_NAME"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "SORT_CODE"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "ACCOUNT_NUMBER"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "PAYMENT_REFERENCE"
type = "string"
required = true

# --- Scenarios (fictional) --------------------------------------------------------
# Each scenario is a debtor and debt. The stage of the sequence (LETTER_DATE,
